text:
Maria (product): Quick idea — add an "effective token cost" column to the cost dashboard per-route + per-model. Shows the real billable token cost after cache savings and prefetch amortization. simple UX: list + tooltip + canary preview.
AJ (eng): How do you want to attribute cache savings? per-request prefix hits, or amortize across session?
Leah (data): Sampling + heuristics. We can compute exact attribution for sampled traces then extrapolate. prefer: attribute direct prefix hits to the route that produced the prefix, amortize shared prefetch across sessions by first-touch.
Ben (infra): watch out for double-counting prefetched tokens. If prefetch cached for 10 routes, we either split credit or mark as global cache saving and show per-route prorated share. neither is perfect.
Oliver (design): For UI: small "effective cost" column, tooltip with breakdown: raw token cost, cache saved, prefetch amortization, model footprint. Inline canary preview: slider for traffic pct shows estimated delta in daily spend.
Maria (product): API surface needed for console: endpoint returning breakdown for route+model over window. sample prototype below:
```
GET /v1/metrics/econ?route=chat.write&model=gpt-redwood-7b&window=24h
Response:
{
  "tokens": 123456,
  "raw_token_cost": 12.34,
  "cache_saved_tokens": 34567,
  "prefetch_amortized_cost": 1.23,
  "effective_token_cost": 0.000089
}
```
AJ (eng): That response shape is fine. Implementation note: compute cache_saved_tokens from cache hits table join. we'll need consistent sampling flags so the extrapolation stays stable.
Leah (data): Sampling plan: full tracing at 1% for attribution signals, 10% for latency traces; aggregated metrics use extrapolation with confidence intervals. store CI in response.
Ben (infra): Also add a "guardrail" field for observability: if extrapolation CI > 20% mark metric as unreliable in UI. otherwise product teams will misinterpret.
Oliver (design): Good call. UI: show a yellow warning badge when unreliable. For canary cost preview, run a dry-run simulation from last 24h workload and show estimated cost delta + %CI.
Maria (product): Rollout plan: feature flag behind econ-preview; canary in console for 2 internal teams first. Need an RFC + small migration to metrics API. Who picks up backend?
AJ (eng): I can own API + sampling changes. estimate 2 sprints.
Leah (data): I'll own the extrapolation logic and CI. will sketch SQL and a validation job.
Ben (infra): I'll add the sampling hooks and make sure metrics pipeline tags sample_group and tracer_id. need to confirm BigQuery slot cost.
Oliver (design): I'll mock the UI and the canary preview sparkline. deliver hi-fi by next week.
Maria (product): Great. Small question: how do we account for routing fallbacks? if a route falls back to cheaper model sometimes, effective cost should show weighted mix.
AJ (eng): include route->model mapping per-invocation; effective_token_cost = sum(invocation_costs) / sum(billed_tokens). invocation_costs incorporate model SKU price * tokens minus cache credits. simple formula in SQL below.
Leah (data): Proposed SQL pseudo:
```sql
select route, sum(model_price * billed_tokens - cache_credit - prefetch_credit) / sum(billed_tokens) as effective_cost
from invocations where window = @w group by route
```
Ben (infra): We'll need to surface model_price history for rollouts — pin price by model_version to avoid retroactive changes.
Maria (product): Nice. Any objections to putting this in the console as "Econ: effective token cost" with canary preview?
Oliver (design): no objections. request: small tooltip copy + link to docs explaining sampling and CI.
Leah (data): Also add a link to a breakdown table: sample size, sample rate, CI, and the top contributors to cache savings.
AJ (eng): Implementation risk: high cardinality routes could explode cost table joins. we'll pre-aggregate by route/model/epoch.
Ben (infra): I'll add retention rules and backfill allowances.
deploy-bot: deployed econ-preview v0.1 to staging :rocket: (sha: a1b2c3)
Maria (product): Perfect. Next steps: AJ open RFC, Leah attach the sample SQL and validation plan, Oliver provides mocks. I'll schedule sync with two internal teams for canary next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
AJ (eng): Will open RFC today, pinging @Leah and @Oliver.
Leah (data): will drop initial CI threshold experiments into RFC.
Ben (infra): I'll add sampling config PR.
Maria (product): Thanks everyone — keep comments inline on RFC.
